name: AgentMesh
description: AI news, iPhone guides and iOS apps: utilities and games on the App Store.

apps.name: Tuck: AI Screenshot Organizer
apps.alternateName: 收好 Tuck－AI 截圖整理
apps.description: Screenshots piling up? Tuck's AI reads every screenshot and file you save: bookings, receipts and warranties, and the restaurants, recipes and things to buy you screenshot. It files each one and finds it again from a few words. Reading happens on your device, with Apple Intelligence where available; Advanced reading by Claude is optional.

apps.name: Inside: Phone Check
apps.description: A warm, clear look at your whole phone: checks, hardware, battery, performance, charging.

apps.name: Roomory: Floor Plans
apps.description: From moving a sofa to planning a renovation, Roomory helps you turn the space you have into the layout you want. Scan a room or start by hand, then edit your floor plans and preview your ideas in 3D.

apps.name: Daikon: Period Tracker
apps.alternateName: 蘿蔔日記 Daikon－經期紀錄

apps.name: ZaiRi: Plant Watering Reminder
apps.alternateName: 栽日 ZaiRi－植物澆水提醒
apps.description: Give every plant day a place to grow.

apps.name: Nightvane: Star Guide
apps.description: Hold your iPhone or iPad up to the night and Nightvane shows what you are looking at: stars, planets, constellations, the Moon and the Milky Way, right where they are.

apps.name: Lockwater: Canal Puzzle
apps.description: Lockwater is a canal puzzle made of soft clay: a row of stone chambers, a few wooden gates, and boats that must reach the flag of their color.

apps.name: Prawnlight: Prawn Hall Tycoon
apps.alternateName: 夜釣蝦場 Prawnlight－釣蝦場大亨
apps.description: Prawnlight is a management game set in a Taiwanese indoor prawn-fishing hall that stays open late into the night. You are the boss, not the angler: order stock, release prawns, lay out the floor, hire staff and keep the guests fishing until closing time.

apps.name: Precision Parking 3D
apps.description: Slow down. Find your angle. Make every space count.
